hits.full_text: Pinned post asking what work remains once AI can build anything, pointing to a video about personal software replacing the old software era.
hits.original_en: Pinned post asking what work remains once AI can build anything, pointing to a video about personal software replacing the old software era.
hits.hook: What work is left when AI can build everything?
hits.draft_en: If AI can build anything, what work is left? Plenty, actually. The old software era is giving way to personal software, built for one person instead of everyone, and coding is no longer the bottleneck. What remains is spotting the right problem, shaping the product, and reaching the people it serves.

hits.name: levelsio
hits.text: Advice to keep VPS ports closed and reach a server only through Tailscale for SSH and a Cloudflare Tunnel for web traffic, after a report that agents can now run a full hacking loop against one exposed port.
hits.full_text: Advice to keep VPS ports closed and reach a server only through Tailscale for SSH and a Cloudflare Tunnel for web traffic, after a report that agents can now run a full hacking loop against one exposed port.
hits.original_en: Advice to keep VPS ports closed and reach a server only through Tailscale for SSH and a Cloudflare Tunnel for web traffic, after a report that agents can now run a full hacking loop against one exposed port.
hits.hook: Close VPS ports; reach servers only via Tailscale and Tunnel.
hits.draft_en: Close every port on your VPS, then open access only inside Tailscale for SSH and through a Cloudflare Tunnel for web traffic. The warning behind it is stark: agents can now handle the whole hacking loop end to end, and one open port is enough for a Linux box to be taken over. A stopgap while you are away is switching port-forwarding off entirely.

outsiders.hook: Gemini advice for the next 10 years, ten points.
outsiders.draft_en: Asked for advice for the next 10 years with no explanations, Gemini answered with 10 points, and the list is surprisingly physical: build strength and endurance, learn skills you can use offline, guard your attention and sleep, kill consumer debt, and lean on your local community. The throughline is agency: understand automation instead of just consuming it, keep your overhead low, and stay adaptable when institutions wobble.

outsiders.original_en: Report that Anthropic added a rule barring Claude Code from recreating existing video games to prevent copyright infringement, while original games and existing genres stay allowed.
outsiders.hook: Anthropic bars Claude Code from recreating existing games.
outsiders.draft_en: Anthropic just drew a line around its coding tool: Claude Code may no longer rebuild existing video games. The reason is copyright, and the carve-out matters: brand-new games and games inside existing genres are still fine. So remakes are out, original work is in.

outsiders.original_en: Clip of an Anthropic engineer explaining that Opus 5.5 should not be prompted directly but used inside a system that prompts itself, with 90 percent of Anthropic engineers already building such systems.
outsiders.hook: Do not prompt Opus 5.5; build a system that prompts itself.
outsiders.draft_en: Stop prompting Opus 5.5 directly. That is the message from inside Anthropic: build a setup that prompts itself instead, keeps memory of past runs, corrects its own errors, and improves each time it runs. The claim is that 90 percent of Anthropic engineers already work this way, which says a lot about where agents are headed.

outsiders.draft_en: One prompt, 2 minutes, and under 1% usage buys a live dashboard for your whole fleet of Grok Bot agents. Instead of opening 15 chats to check who is stuck, every team gets its own floor in a 3D office, and each bot shows its status and usage live. New bots walk in by themselves as the roster updates, so you manage the company from one view instead of chasing tabs.

trend_radar.legend: Trend match 0-100% = 1 - prod(1 - w) over matched 24 h keywords that another author also used in the 48 h window (w: rank 1-10 0.35, 11-25 0.22, 26-40 0.12, curated 0.20). Verdict: >= 50% -> trend; else video/image in the post data -> visual; else >= 100K followers (outsiders without follower data: >= 500K views, estimate) -> author/audience; else coincidence/other. Missing data shows as 'no data'. Heat = sum log10(views) of topic posts (24 h x1, 24-48 h x0.5), scaled to 100. Momentum = log-views last 24 h / previous 24 h. Trend-input-only accounts feed the corpus but are never shown as hits.
